I'll review `PR.diff` and the surrounding source for bugs, fail-open paths, missed events, pagination/trust, validation, and partial writes.Continuing through the main logic changes in `review-status.mjs` and `review-router.mjs`.Inspecting critical logic in the changed source files for fail-open and trust issues.Checking a few more edge cases to confirm the severity-marker and trust findings.## Findings

### Major — `scripts/github/review-status.mjs:886-888` + `:335-337` (bugs / fail-open)
`hasReviewContent` treats a severity marker alone as enough review content, and `codeRabbitHeadReview` uses that for `reviewedHead`. Live outside-diff-only bodies already match `OUTSIDE_DIFF_HEADING`, so the `severityMarks` arm is wider than needed. A CodeRabbit COMMENTED “reply” review on the head whose body quotes a finding (`</picture> Minor` / emoji + severity) sets `reviewedHead: true` and can make READY skip a real head review / carry. Tests still assume replies are empty (`review-status.test.mjs` F4); they do not cover a quoted finding body.

### Major — `scripts/github/review-router.mjs:398-412` (partial writes)
`applyOps` applies `labels` then `comment-update`/`comment-create` with no rollback. `execFileSync`-backed `gh` throws on failure, so labels can stick while the new `consumed` line never lands. The anti-replay rule then fails: the same `pathway-confirmed` marker can checkpoint again on undo → UI ready. That breaks the invariant this PR adds.

### Major — `scripts/github/review-status.mjs:517`, `:293-298`, `:934-942` (external-data trust / fail-open)
Comment trust still uses `userContentEdits(first:20)` (newest first). `commentEditedAfterApp` / `appCommentForeignEditor` only see that window; if a person edit ages out and later app edits fill the page, both return trusted. This PR promotes `trustedCodeRabbitSummary` into the READY carry path via `newestCodeRabbitRound` (and into `cr-fix`’s carry source), so a tampered summary can become a clean `summaryOnly` round and unlock READY.

### Minor — `scripts/github/review-status.mjs:940` (bugs / false negative)
`newestCodeRabbitRound` rejects a clean summary when any CodeRabbit review shares `commit_id === covered`, including empty-body thread replies. `newestCodeRabbitReview` ignores empty bodies; this check does not. A reply on that commit can hide a valid summary-only carry source and force another paid review.

### Minor — `scripts/github/cr-fix.mjs:159-183` (partial writes)
`save()` failure only becomes a stderr note; stdout still prints the pasteable `CLI fix review: …` line (including `clean`). READY trusts the PR body line, so a failed local artifact write does not stop a “clean” attestation from being pasted.

### Minor — `scripts/github/review-router.mjs:366-367` (input validation)
`renderComment` uses `consumed ? …`, so `consumed === 0` is omitted. `stateFrom` can still parse `id=0`. Unlikely for GitHub ids, but a zero id would not round-trip.

---

Skipped empty categories. Pagination in `readIssueComments` fails closed on bad/repeated cursors and page errors; that path looks sound.
